name: Green DR | 175mg Gummies | Feel Good CBD
description:
Experience the ultimate in pain relief with Trifecta CBD Pain Gummy Bears. Our carefully crafted blend of CBD, CBN, and CBG provides a high dose of cannabinoids to address your discomfort. Trust the amazing feedback from our customers and try it for yourself.

Our Trifecta CBD Pain Gummy Bears are formulated with a powerful blend of CBD, CBG, CBN, and special terpenes, Experience the amazing benefits of this popular product and its ability to work with our receptors for ultimate relief.

Usage:

Enjoy 1/3 to 1 gummy every 3-5 hours, or as needed
Or 1 full gummy before bedtime
Dosage will vary for each person
Usually takes 30 to 45 minutes to take effect
Ingredients:

Lavender
Chamomile
Passion Flower Herb
Full-Spectrum CBD Oil
CBN
CBG
Vitamin Water
Natural colors and flavors
